title: 第五章 开始操作工藤新一
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在假面超人追着琴酒和伏特加离开后，草地上只剩下一个趴在地上生死不明的工藤新一了。

不，又有脚步声接近了。

一只完全黑色的脚踏入草地中，带起一串沙沙的声音。视线上抬，来人不仅是脚，整个身体都是漆黑的，月光勾勒了他的轮廓，照亮了他的狞笑。

渚琰·小黑人背着一个背包，低头打量着工藤新一。

工藤新一的眼睛还是半睁着，但意识已经处于涣散状态，完全没有察觉到有人靠近。

接着工藤新一抽搐起来，口中发出痛苦的呻吟，那声音越来越大，变成一声惨嚎。

然后在小黑人的注视下，工藤新一的身体愈发扭曲，开始像漏气一般缩小，死神小学生闪亮登场。

工藤新一缩水成矮冬瓜娃后，就顶着一脑袋的血昏迷了。

小黑人唤出了系统，调出角色卡：“开始扮演【工藤新一】！”

依旧是从脚开始，由下至上的，一个活生生的工藤新一变了出来。

只不过和躺在地上的那个缩水版工藤新一的穿着的运动衫不同，渚琰·工藤新一穿的是角色卡上的打扮，帝丹高中的西装式校服。

小黑人与工藤新一相对而立，一回生二回熟，这次渚琰很轻松就适应了从两线操作变成三线操作。

然后渚琰·小黑人四处看了看，转身走了。

而渚琰·工藤新一却抬手解开自己的领带，接着又脱下校服外套，随手丢在地上。

白色的衬衫也丢在了草地上，工藤新一开始解开腰带。

西装裤子也脱掉了，就连袜子和鞋也不放过。

最后——工藤新一，他背对着月亮！掀起了兜裆布！

月亮似乎觉得没眼再看下去了，躲在了乌云的后面，喻示着一场大雨即将来临。

【玩家难道是想换上原版工藤新一的衣服，立刻追上毛利兰开始扮演？】

“我没你那么傻。”工藤新一毫不客气的说道：“柯南想要证明自己是工藤新一其实很容易，现在就换上他的衣服，开始扮演假装无事发生，只要他证明了身份我就很被动。”

“所以我要，让柯南也以为我是工藤新一。”

这时小黑人回来了，手里捧着一个空的大号纸壳箱，上面画着水蜜桃。

小黑人浑身肌肉细条，看起来像紧身衣，也像梅川衣。

工藤新一真的梅川衣，优渥的生活让他的皮肤又白又嫩。

白色的君子坦蛋蛋，黑色的小人藏戚戚。

两具身体面对面，将彼此的模样尽收眼底，渚琰忍不住笑了，小黑人和工藤新一一起发出了阴险又邪恶的笑声。

就连已经跑出了热带乐园之外的琴酒和伏特加，都听到了身后追逐不休的假面超人发出一串猥琐的笑声，逃命的脚步都快了几分。

等到渚琰止住了笑容，小黑人将水果箱递给了工藤新一。工藤新一把水果箱的底部也

而小黑人从地上捡起了那根水管，因为被琴酒用来打过假面骑士，水管有些弯了。

然后工藤新一背对着小黑人，小黑人举起水管，不断的调整角度。以假面骑士的视角，渚琰清楚的看到了琴酒殴打工藤新一的那一下，无论的高度还是角度，都要模仿的一分不差！

Duang~！

梅开三度，遭到重击的工藤新一当即腿软，单膝跪在了地上。

不过似乎是小黑人的力气比琴酒小了一些，工藤新一没有当场扑街，缓了一会后站了起来，一手提着纸箱，一手捂着后脑勺。

小黑人把水管丢回原处，然后捡起地上自带的工藤新一的衣服，包括手机钥匙钱包什么的，统统塞进了背包里。

Page (1/3)

After Masked Superman chased Gin and Vodka away, only Kudo Shinichi was left lying on the grass with his life and death unknown.

No, there are footsteps approaching again.

A completely black foot stepped into the grass, causing a series of rustling sounds.Looking up, he saw that not only his feet, but his entire body were dark. The moonlight outlined his outline and illuminated his evil smile.

Zhu Yan, the little black man, was carrying a backpack and looked down at Kudo Shinichi.

Kudo Shinichi's eyes were still half-open, but his consciousness was already in a state of confusion, and he was completely unaware of anyone approaching.

Then Kudo Shinichi convulsed and groaned in pain. The sound became louder and louder, turning into a miserable howl.

Then, under the gaze of the little black man, Kudo Shinichi's body became more and more distorted and began to shrink like a leak, and the Shinigami primary school student made his debut.

After Kudo Shinichi shrank into a short winter melon baby, he passed out with a head full of blood.

The little black man called up the system and called up the character card: "Start playing [Kudo Shinichi]!"

Still starting from the feet, working from bottom to top, a living Kudo Shinichi emerged.

It's just that unlike the sweatshirt worn by the shrunken version of Kudo Shinichi lying on the ground, Nagisa and Kudo Shinichi are wearing the outfit on the character card, the suit-style uniform of Teitan High School.

The little black man and Kudo Shinichi stood opposite each other, and they became familiar with each other. This time, Nagisa easily adapted from the two-line operation to the third-line operation.

Then Zhuyan, the little black man, looked around, turned around and left.

But Nagisa Kudo Shinichi raised his hand to untie his tie, then took off his school uniform jacket and threw it on the ground.

The white shirt was also thrown on the grass, and Kudo Shinichi began to unbutton his belt.

The suit pants were also taken off, even the socks and shoes were left on.

Finally - Kudo Shinichi, his back is to the moon!Lift the crotch cloth!

The moon seemed to have no eyes to see anymore and hid behind the dark clouds, indicating that a heavy rain was coming.

[Does the player want to put on the original Kudo Shinichi's clothes and immediately catch up with Mao Lilan and start playing?】

"I'm not as stupid as you." Kudo Shinichi said unceremoniously: "It's actually very easy for Conan to prove that he is Kudo Shinichi. Now put on his clothes and start pretending that nothing happened. As long as he proves his identity, I will be very passive."

"So I want to make Conan think that I am Kudo Shinichi."

At this time, the little black man came back, holding an empty large cardboard box with peaches painted on it.

The little black man has thin muscles all over his body and looks like a tights or Umikawa clothes.

Kudo Shinichi's real Umegawa Yi, the good life makes his skin white and tender.

The white gentleman hides his balls, while the black villain hides his emotions.

The two bodies faced each other, with each other's appearance in full view. Zhu Yan couldn't help but laugh, and the little black man and Kudo Shinichi let out a sinister and evil laugh together.

Even Gin and Vodka, who had already run out of the tropical paradise, heard a string of obscene laughter from the Masked Superman chasing after them, and their escape steps were a little faster.

When Nagisa stopped smiling, the little black man handed the fruit box to Kudo Shinichi.The bottom of Kudo Shinichi’s fruit box is also

The little black man picked up the water pipe from the ground. Because Gin used it to beat the Kamen Rider, the water pipe was a little bent.

Then Kudo Shinichi turned his back to the little black man, who raised the water pipe and kept adjusting the angle.From the Kamen Rider's perspective, Nagisa clearly saw the moment when Gin beat Kudo Shinichi. No matter the height or angle, he had to imitate it exactly!

Duang~!

Kudo Shinichi, who scored three times and was hit hard, immediately lost his legs and knelt on one knee.

However, it seemed that the little black man was a little weaker than Gin. Kudo Shinichi did not rush to the street on the spot. After a while, he stood up, holding the cardboard box in one hand and covering the back of his head with the other.

The little black man threw the water pipe back to its place, then picked up Kudo Shinichi's clothes from the ground, including his mobile phone, keys, wallet, etc., and stuffed them all into his backpack.
